h_phi_audit.reason: This pass added static measurement and atlas/report artifacts only. It did not edit runtime systems, so it cannot honestly claim improved runtime DataVault sovereignty without a separate implementation pass.
h_phi_audit.desired_lookup_model: stateless typed signal or GlobalDataVault lookup; no private per-system buffer ownership hidden from static audit

toaster_i3.purpose: Celeron/i3 audit path keeps the JSON small for dashboards that only need gate state.

main_mx350.purpose: Default SHINOBU ingest path with full counters, domain metrics, and dependency PNG.

rtx_overkill.visual_overkill: networkx/matplotlib graph plus top edge fields for high-end architecture dashboards

interpretation.mathematical_state: H-Phi is a static product of typed signal density, dispatcher/job purity, DataVault/native ownership visibility, and struct layout explicitness. Low values mean architecture pressure remains concentrated in direct calls, Unity loop debt, local native surfaces, or unmanaged-layout debt. This is not runtime proof.
interpretation.low_tier: Use typed lanes and dispatcher phases to keep cheap hardware predictable; shed optional visual consumers first.
interpretation.middle_tier: Keep full gameplay snapshots bounded and avoid new Core gravity.
interpretation.high_tier: Spend saved CPU on VISUAL_SYNC consumers, not gameplay broadcast cost.
interpretation.ultra_tier: Attach visual overkill through read-only snapshots and quality gates without mutating simulation truth.

residual_risk: STATIC_SOURCE only. Unity import, Unity Console, Play Mode, profiler, GCMonitor, player build, frame-time, memory, scene wiring, save/load, and visual quality remain PENDING VERIFICATION.
Direct method call counting is a regex pressure signal, not semantic dataflow.
Domain indexing is parsed from Docs/Actual Domains of Project.txt and should remain aligned with that authority file.
